sections.section_name: Section A - Choose the Correct Answer

questions.question_text: Which place in our neighbourhood helps us mail letters and send parcels?
Which of these is a body-building food that helps our muscles grow?
Who makes up a basic nuclear family?
options: D) Neighbors living in the same building

questions.question_text: What do plants primarily need from nature to grow healthy and strong?
Which public place in a neighbourhood is meant for walking, relaxing, and playing outdoors?
Which of these is considered a healthy personal habit before eating food?
options: B) Washing hands with soap and water
questions.answer: B) Washing hands with soap and water

questions.question_text: Which of the following animals is usually found living in the branches of trees?
Where do we go when we are sick or injured in our neighbourhood?
Which of these is NOT allowed when you are exploring on a nature trail?
Which food group gives us the energy to play, run, and work all day?
Why is 'Living Together' in a community or family beneficial for human beings? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Living together helps us share work, keep each other safe, celebrate festivals together, and support one another in times of need.

questions.question_text: Name two important public services in your neighbourhood and mention what they do. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: The hospital treats sick people with medicine, and the local fire station sends strong fire engines and firefighters to put out dangerous building fires.

questions.question_text: Why is it important to include fresh fruits and vegetables in our daily diet? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Fresh fruits and vegetables contain essential vitamins and minerals. They protect us from falling ill frequently and keep our immune system very healthy and strong.

questions.question_text: What are two things you can learn by observing plants during a nature trail? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: We can learn about the different shapes of green leaves and closely observe how tiny insects like bees collect sweet nectar from colorful blooming flowers.

questions.question_text: How do trees help in keeping our environment clean and healthy? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Trees take in harmful carbon dioxide and give out fresh oxygen for us to breathe. They also provide cooling shade and clean the surrounding air.

questions.question_text: Imagine you are setting up a small garden in your neighbourhood. Describe the types of plants you will grow and how you will care for them. [40-50 words]
questions.answer: I will plant colorful flowers like marigolds and useful herbs like mint and basil. I will care for them by watering them daily in the morning, removing annoying weeds, and using natural compost to help them grow healthy and very strong.

questions.question_text: Imagine you have to plan a healthy lunchbox for your school picnic. Describe the food items you will pack and why. [40-50 words]
questions.answer: I will pack a vegetable sandwich made with brown bread, a fresh apple, and a small handful of almonds. These foods provide long-lasting energy, essential vitamins for health, and do not make me feel lazy like oily junk food usually does.

questions.question_text: Explain how you can be a good neighbor and help in keeping your neighborhood clean and friendly. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: I can be a good neighbor by greeting people politely and helping the elderly carry their heavy groceries. To keep the neighborhood clean, I will always throw garbage in the correct dustbins, avoid wasting water on the streets, and invite my friends to plant more trees in our local community park.

questions.question_text: How can you help protect small animals and birds that live in your surroundings during the hot summer months? [50-60 words]
questions.answer: During the hot summer, I can help birds by keeping a shallow clay bowl filled with fresh water on the balcony or terrace for them to drink and bathe safely. I can also scatter some grains for them to eat and ensure small stray animals have a shaded place to rest quietly.
